text:
alex: quick sync after the postmortem — we have recurring pattern: broad flag rollouts without a quick rollback hook + insufficient per-route caps. want a concise action list and owners so we close the loop.

tariq: I can take a stab at a small rollback API that feature teams can call (idempotent, emits audit). timeline: prototype in 1 week, follow-up PR in 2.

sophie: i'll own the policy side (per-route caps + soft-approvals). will draft a policy DSL and enforcement points.

elaine: ops request: when rollback happens, oncall needs an automated verification checklist and a single link to the incident snapshot. i'll own the runbook bits.

rollout-bot: info: recent-rollout monitor triggered 3 alerts in last 90 days for flags with >20% traffic exposure. see /monitors/rollouts/high-exposure.

alex: proposed high-level:
- small rollback API (flag-toggle + optional traffic-shift)
- rollout policy: default caps = 5% route, 10% org (soft), allow approver override with TTL
- automatic rollback triggers based on metric-deck (error-rate, model-quality delta, latency p95)
- oncall verification checklist + synthetic rollback test harness

tariq: sample API sketch:
```http
POST /internal/rollback
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "flag": "ranker-v3",
  "target": "stable-v2",
  "reason": "metric-spike",
  "initiator": "automation:metric-rule"
}
```

sophie: policy DSL sketch (very small):
```
policy "route-cap" {
  route: "*/rerank"
  cap: 0.05
  soft: true
  approvers: ["platform-lead"]
}
```
will add validation rules in the gateway.

ops-bot: scheduled synthetic rollback test: 1761112700 (staging). will run smoke + verification checks.

elaine: action items (compact list):
- A1: rollback API + audit trail (owner: tariq) — due 2024-06-04
- A2: policy DSL + enforcement at gateway (owner: sophie) — due 2024-05-31
- A3: oncall verification checklist + runbook snippet (owner: elaine) — due 2024-05-28
- A4: synthetic rollback test harness + CI job (owner: tariq + ops) — due 2024-06-07
- A5: dashboard surface for high-exposure flags (owner: alex) — due 2024-06-14

tariq: dependencies: A1 needs audit stream (kinesis) and a safe toggle library from feature-flag svc. i'll open tickets and tag teams.

alex: acceptance quick checks to add inline for each A:
- rollback API: idempotent, emits audit id, reconciliation loop verifies flag state within 30s
- policy DSL: schema validation + unit tests + negative tests for override TTL
- verification checklist: step-by-step with exact metrics + thresholds + example queries
- synthetic test: inject error scenario, expect rollback within threshold window, then verify traffic and metrics

sophie: question: do we want rollback to be fully automatic or require a short human approval window for model-quality regressions? my vote: auto for blatant errors (high error rate), human for quality delta > X.

elaine: agreed — auto for operational failures, human for business-quality regressions. we'll list clear thresholds in the runbook.

rollout-bot: note: deploying rollout-controller 1.0-rc to staging at 1761112600.

alex: recurring-pattern mitigation: add A6: quarterly rollout configuration audit (owner: ops) — due 2024-07-01; plus A7: maintain a tiny 'safe-canary' test suite every rollout must pass for first 10 minutes (owner: sophie) — due 2024-06-10.

tariq: CLI helper for ops to trigger rollback manually if needed:
```bash
# emergency rollback to stable
ri rollback exec --flag ranker-v3 --target stable-v2 --reason "manual ops"
```

sophie: I'll add soft-cap enforcement to the request path so teams can't accidentally exceed defaults. approver flow will add an audit entry and TTL.

elaine: oncall verification checklist draft (short):
1) confirm API response shows flag -> stable-v2
2) confirm traffic % reverted in gateway metrics
3) confirm error-rate back to baseline (5m window)
4) sanity-check sample responses for model output quality
5) if any fail, escalate to platform oncall and file P1 ticket

alex: who will own closing the loop on the postmortem board? i'd like the owner to update status weekly until all A's are done. I'll take that for tracking.

ops-bot: reminder: please attach PR links to the postmortem follow-up board to make audits easier.

tariq: i'll create the tickets and link this thread. expecting to have a prototype rollback endpoint by end of next week.

sophie: i'll open a repo with the DSL parser and sample policies; will ping for design review.

elaine: i'll update the runbook with the checklist and the escalation doc, then drop a small training note for oncall.

alex: thanks all — we'll reconvene in the SRE/Platform sync next Tuesday to check progress. :thumbsup:
